thread:
ashwin: heads-up — noticed SLO card in console shows a sudden spike in "generate latency" breaches after the overnight rollout. viz shows threshold line jumping around; unsure if it's a threshold edit or metric noise. anyone know provenance? can we surface who last edited the threshold + the diff in the UI? cc @jess

jess: we do log edits in audit, but console doesn't surface diffs yet. thinking a small 'last changed by' pill and a hover diff would help. link to audit vs inline diff — which do folks prefer? :thinking_face:

maria: link is fine for deep dive but ops wants inline quick view. mini diff (prev -> new) + the edit comment would be ideal. keep it compact.

sam: also add: need to show the evaluation window/aggregation applied. the chart is currently per-second so it's noisy. show the applied smoothing/rollup (e.g., p95 over 5m) next to the metric.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: noticed config change: slo:latency-threshold for service=gen-api updated at 2024-10-12T03:12Z by jess — comment: "temp relax for canary".

ashwin: practical wishlist: (a) last edit actor + edit comment, (b) effective threshold used by the alert evaluator (post-smoothing), (c) suppression/quiet provenance (was this suppressed by quiet window or auto-snooze? policy id), (d) simulated fanout preview to estimate recipients if we fire.

jess: backend already has endpoints: GET /slo/:id/history and GET /slo/:id/effective?window=5m — APIs exist but console hasn't wired them. we need to define UX contract for the diff snippet and suppression badge. @maria can you mock a compact UI?

maria: yep — i'll do a tiny mock. question: where should fallback routing exposure live? on the SLO card (quick glance) or in the alerting rules panel (detailed)?

sam: SLO card for triage, rules panel for config. also show rate-cap metadata (per-tenant limits) right on the card so on-call isn't surprised when fanout gets truncated.

ashwin: +1 on the card. also want 'quiet provenance' — show whether an alert was suppressed and which policy (id + human reason) triggered suppression. helps triage noisy false positives.

jess: implementation note — we need small schema changes in alert events: add fields suppression_reason and evaluated_threshold. telemetry pipeline will need to map those through.

maria: rough estimate: 2d backend work (schema + endpoints) + 1d frontend + small telemetry mapping. can this fit next sprint?

sam: fine as MVP: show last editor, effective threshold, and a suppression badge. rollout behind feature flag.

ashwin: can we add a small 'preview' button that calls the fanout-sim API (uses routing policies, current quotas, fallback rules) and returns estimated recipients & whether rate caps will drop recipients? this avoids surprises during incidents.

jess: we have a fanout-sim prototype. i'll wire it behind a flag and call SRE for load tests.

ashwin: thanks — filed a ticket: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/4567 — assigning to jess/maria. i'll add acceptance criteria: audit diff inline, effective threshold display, suppression provenance badge, and fanout preview behind flag.

maria: noted. will post mock in the thread when ready. :sparkles:
